content.short: Reown is the leading Web3 infrastructure provider behind WalletConnect, offering SDKs for a seamless user experience.
content.description: Reown is the definitive Web3 infrastructure provider, formerly known as WalletConnect, dedicated to providing the essential tools needed for seamless and secure on-chain user experiences. The platform offers a comprehensive suite of SDKs, including AppKit and WalletKit, which allow developers to integrate intuitive wallet connections, social logins, and cross-chain functionality into their applications with ease. Reown acts as the foundational communication layer for the decentralized web, powering thousands of dApps and millions of user sessions daily for global users.
content.meta: Reown provides essential SDKs and infrastructure for seamless wallet connectivity. Discover Reown and more on the Lancers Web3 Explorer platform.
